# Parley v0.1.41

One fix: sending a reviewed Context Pack no longer freezes the app. Nothing
else changed.

## Ask with Context froze Parley

In v0.1.40, confirming **Ask with Context** on an agent-staged draft, or
**Approve and Ask** on an agent's context Ask, stopped the whole app
responding until it was force-quit. After relaunch the handoff was correctly
recorded as Interrupted; nothing was lost, but nothing was sent either.

The cause was a deadlock. Those two routes waited on Parley's core from the
main thread, with the same long timeout a tracked Ask uses, while the core
finishes the request by pasting into the target pane through the main thread.
Each side was waiting for the other. Every other tracked request from the
toolbar already ran off the main thread; these two did not, and the route had
never been driven by hand before it shipped.

Now the context sheet closes as soon as you confirm, the request runs in the
background exactly like a toolbar Ask, and a result warning or a failure shows
as an alert. The target pane receives the pack; the app stays responsive.

## A repeat becomes an alert, not a freeze

Parley's control client now refuses any request that could wait for minutes if
it is made from the main thread, before it touches the core, and says so:
"Parley refused to wait on its core from the main thread … Nothing was sent."
A future mistake of the same shape produces that alert instead of a frozen
app. Short reads, such as the once-a-second refresh, are unaffected.

## Also

- A new check proves a routing role is refused for a second pane in the same
  workspace and allowed in a different one. That is existing behaviour, now
  pinned; roles are unique per workspace by design.
- `docs/test-scenarios.md` P2.6 records the freeze as a fail condition.

## Compatibility

Agent protocol unchanged at 32; no pane needs restarting; no stored record
changes shape.

Validated: 342 native checks, 53 Node tests, public scan, platform scan and
build. The main-thread guard was watched failing with the guard removed and
passing with it restored.

Not validated here: a context-pack Ask driven by hand in the running app. The
guard turns a regression on that route into an alert rather than a freeze, but
the route itself is P2.6 in `docs/test-scenarios.md` and needs one real run.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
